items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: In fact I was even his guest in the Unites States Senate later on.

ctx.x: Some book says that Huey Long complained that the band was too loud and that the management told you to play softer and you wouldn't.
Oh, that's a lot of baloney. Huey never complained about anything. In fact he was a doll. In fact I was even his guest in the Unites States Senate later on.
Oh. I'm just trying to remember which --
